hook.name: FoundryHookV4R2E2
hook.description: Market-cap-tiered fee hook for bonding-curve token launch pools. Buy-side fees are set as dynamic LP fee overrides; sell-side ETH fees are taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta and held in the hook for off-path locker collection. Pools can graduate to a higher market-cap fee tier once accumulated ETH reaches a threshold.
